transcript.sourceText: Without trade, domestic supply and demand intersect at $7 and 175 thousand avocados. At the $10 world price, domestic consumers buy 100 thousand while domestic producers supply 250 thousand. The country exports the difference: 250 - 100 = 150 thousand avocados.
transcript.text: Without trade, domestic supply and demand intersect at 7 dollars and 175 thousand avocados. At the 10 dollars world price, domestic consumers buy 100 thousand while domestic producers supply 250 thousand. The country exports the difference: 250 minus 100 equals 150 thousand avocados.
